verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh lets users generate dedicated API credentials under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, with configurable permissions and an optional expiry date. Those credentials are exchanged for an access token used on authenticated API calls, so an agent can be given its own scoped, time-limited credential. missing for 10: documentation of how granular the permission scopes are, evidence of revocation or rotation workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
